summary: Two women waving red scarves were spotted outside Jamestown from a Colorado Army National Guard Blackhawk during a flood search on Tuesday, September 17, 2013; Staff Sgt. Jose Pantoja was lowered by winch and hoisted both women into the helicopter, which then dropped them at the Boulder airport
notes: Date inferred: the Weather.com report describes 'Tuesday' searches; 2013-09-17 was the Tuesday in question (article updated 2013-09-17/18); spotter Sgt. 1st Class Keith Bart; September 2013 Front Range flood
